title: The PLANTERS® Brand Launches 2026 Winter Collection
summary: The PLANTERS® brand is bringing back its annual limited-time winter collection.
body_markdown:
Fan favorites Cinnamon Butter Pecans and Toasted Marshmallow Hot Chocolate Cashews are back, alongside three festive mixes: Brittle Nut Medley, Holiday Nut Crunch and Winter Spiced Mix. Two almond flavors also join the lineup, with Cinnamon & Brown Sugar Almonds available exclusively at Walmart and an expanded size of Maple Brown Sugar Almonds exclusively offered at Sam’s Club.


## The PLANTERS® BRAND winter collection includes:


- **PLANTERS® Cinnamon Butter Pecans (5.5 oz.):** Kettle-roasted with cinnamon and butter, these pecans are a crunchy shortcut to holiday spirit. Available at select locations of Walmart, Kroger, Hy-Vee, CVS, Wakefern, WinCo, Giant, Albertsons, Raley’s and Demoulas, as well as on Amazon.
- **PLANTERS® Toasted Marshmallow Hot Chocolate Cashews (5.5 oz.):** Fire-roasted cashews seasoned with toasted marshmallow and hot chocolate flavors for a bite that tastes like dessert. Available at select locations of Walmart, Kroger, Hy-Vee, CVS, Wakefern, WinCo, Giant, Albertsons, Raley’s and Demoulas, as well as on Amazon.
- **PLANTERS® Brittle Nut Medley (19.25 oz.):** Honey-roasted peanuts, yogurt-covered raisins, peanut brittle, pretzels and cashews combine for a mix with a little something for everyone. Available at select locations of Walmart, Hy-Vee and Brookshire’s, as well as on Amazon.
- **PLANTERS® Holiday Nut Crunch (21 oz.):** A festive mix of roasted peanuts, almonds and cashews, paired with raisins, chocolate-covered peanuts and candied pieces for a sweet and salty holiday snack. Available at select locations of Walmart, Hy-Vee and Brookshire’s, as well as on Amazon.
- **PLANTERS® Winter Spiced Mix (18.75 oz.):** Honey-roasted peanuts, almonds, honey-roasted sesame sticks, cashews and pecans are lightly seasoned with sea salt for a blend of sweet and savory flavors. Available at select locations of Walmart, Hy-Vee and Brookshire’s, as well as on Amazon.
- **PLANTERS® Cinnamon & Brown Sugar Almonds (15.25 oz.):** Roasted in peanut oil and seasoned with cinnamon and brown sugar, these almonds make a sweet, savory snack. Available exclusively at Walmart.
- **PLANTERS® Maple Brown Sugar Almonds (25 oz.):** Almonds featuring the nostalgic flavor of maple brown sugar in every bite. The expanded party size, perfect for holiday gatherings, is exclusively available at Sam’s Club.


“As consumers look for simple ways to elevate holiday entertaining, PLANTERS® seasonal nut flavors and festive mixes provide a delicious, shareable option for gathering with friends and family,” said Lanessa Aurand, brand manager of the[PLANTERS® brand](https://www.planters.com/) . “Once something shows up in the bowl around the holidays, it starts to feel like a tradition. From cinnamon butter pecans to cashews with the familiar flavor of hot chocolate and toasted marshmallows, our winter collection brings a little extra holiday spirit to every handful.”


The PLANTERS® brand winter 2026 collection is available now at select retailers nationwide and will remain on shelves throughout the holiday season.
